question: Can a cheap model assign real requests to the right worker role as well as the baseline model?
setup: 12 real goals covering every worker role in the author's assistant setup; the same router prompt sent to 3 models, one-shot, one batch each. Ground truth (one role per goal) was fixed by one rater before scoring. Not the same test as E06b.
finding: gpt-6-luna and glm-5.3-flash matched all 12 assignments; deepseek-v4-flash matched 11 (goal 11, a debug-and-fix task, went to main instead of advisor, a borderline call). Per batch, deepseek-v4-flash was the cheapest ($0.00009) but the slowest (21 s vs 13 s for luna); glm-5.3-flash ($0.000108) was cheaper than luna ($0.000135) with the same accuracy.
limitations: n=12 goals, one batch run per model (no repeats)
assignment tested offline, not the live decomposer latency
ground truth set a priori by one rater
notes: Models were called through an OpenAI-compatible router; names and prices are as recorded at run time.
